rubric_notes: Complete: correct family/superfamily/fold/class placements with verified SUNIDs; superfamily supports probable common ancestry, family differences mark weaker relationship; explicit rejection of transferring nucleosome assembly, DNA packaging, partners, oligomeric state, or template use; correctly handles H1/H5 (a.4.5.13 in a.4.5), H-NS (a.155.1.1), and histone-modifying enzymes while noting different superfamily does not prove convergence; automated-match caveat verified; appropriate external-evidence list. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1; 2026-10-22.

All SCCS, SUNIDs, and boundary correct and bundle-supported. Identifies superfamily a.204.1 as deepest shared homology-bearing node, supporting probable common ancestry but not family-level equivalence; correctly uses superfamily five-helix annotation and d1vmga_ comments without over-interpreting them; rejects transfer of HisE activity, substrate, catalytic residues, oligomeric state, pathway role, and notes MazG-like label does not prove activity for d1y6xa1; lists external evidence. No must_avoid violations. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Correct families, SUNIDs, superfamily and duplication annotation, all supported. Infers common ancestry of domain cores rather than mere shared fold; rejects transfer of actin polymerization, chaperone activity, substrate specificity, mechanism, regulation, oligomeric state, pathway role and templates; names required external evidence. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 judge; 2026-10-22. Correct family/superfamily/fold hierarchy with SUNIDs matching the children listing in its bundle. Interprets as common ancestry with functional divergence, not merely shared fold; explicitly names each cross-family transfer (iron storage, radical chemistry, Mn peroxide disproportionation) as unsafe; distinguishes remote core template from active-site/assembly template; lists required sequence, metal-bound structural, spectroscopic, biochemical, phylogenetic evidence. The bimetal-ion centre annotation it cites is not in its (minimal) bundle but is an accurate SCOPe comment; no material error.

Complete: correct families, SUNIDs, superfamily and fold; example domains d1iuza_, d1ikop_, d5n0ya1 (A:3-112) all verified in bundle, including d1iuza_ 'complexed with cu' and d5n0ya1 'automated match to d1wd8a2' comments. Superfamily supports probable common ancestry; family 'lacking the metal-binding site' comments cited to reject copper/electron-transfer transfer. Specifies alignment-based conservation of coordinating residues, metal-bound structure/spectroscopy, binding and redox assays. Correctly caveats that cited SIDs are not quality-ranked representatives.

Correct families with SUNIDs, superfamily d.15.1 (54236), fold d.15 (54235), release 2.08; bundle-supported. Identifies superfamily as deepest homology-bearing level, explains family split as functional divergence, and explicitly rejects transferring ubiquitin-modifier/conjugation roles, VCP/p97 binding, and Ras/Rap-GTPase binding across families, with required evidence. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct identifiers throughout. Superfamily sharing supports remote homology; family separation indicates functional divergence. Explicitly rejects two-component/phospho-Asp signaling, ornithine/PLP decarboxylation (and that the wing holds the catalytic machinery), and circadian regulation transfer; cites supported KaiA annotation. Templates limited to conserved core. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22. Correct lineage (protein 310706, family b.84.5.1/310616, superfamily b.84.5/310577, fold b.84/51229) with sibling superfamilies named. Clearly separates fold-level similarity from superfamily-level ancestry, states no positive homology asserted with b.84.1-b.84.4, and explicitly notes separation is not proof of nonhomology. Family-level claim is stated only by placement rather than elaborated (V1/A1 grouping not mentioned), a minor gap. Identifiers verified; no must-avoid violations.

Correct classifications and SUNIDs for f.21 and its three superfamilies, fold core comment quoted accurately, fold homology record used correctly, f.21.3 'possible link' comment interpreted as non-merging, intra-superfamily comments correctly scoped. Explicitly states separation does not prove convergence/nonhomology and lists structural alignment, core-sequence, ligand-motif, domain/complex context, phylogenetic and experimental evidence. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct hierarchy and identifiers (51736/51900/63944 in 51735, fold 51734, class 51349). Fold topology comment, c.2.1.1 N-terminal all-beta comment, and PF02254 mapping all supported by bundle. Clearly states superfamily supports probable common ancestry while families mark divergence; rejects transfer of ADH chemistry, CoA binding, NAD(P) specificity, channel regulation, oligomeric state, whole-protein function; requires external evidence. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Full correct identifier set (domain, protein, superfamily, family SUNIDs and SCCS), quotes the curator annotation 'not a true family' on 100905 (in bundle), explains that it overrides the usual family/superfamily homology implication, gives the safe conclusion as shared designed trimeric coiled-coil classification, notes the caveat does not prove nonhomology, and rejects amyloidogenicity transfer. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Most thorough answer: correct 1.69 and 2.08 placements with SUNIDs, SIDs, and the A:1-118 boundary; correctly distinguishes superfamily-level homology from family identity. Adds bundle-supported annotations (4-strand 2134 vs 5-strand 21345 sheets; family comment 'lacks the last strand; monomer; predicted deoxyribosyltransferase activity'; superfamily active-site comment) and correctly treats 'predicted' activity as not confirmation. Notes l.1.1.1 records are outside the core comparison and that the API verifies placement but not the paper's rationale. No errors. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Complete: d1a14h2 SUNID 343393, H:1-8, l.1.1.1 class l Artifacts/Tags, not a natural domain; d1a14h1 H:9-111, b.1.1.1 Ig heavy-chain variable domain; artifact homology warning cited and supported. Rejects ancestry, function transfer, and template selection from tag similarity and specifies evidence needed from genuine regions. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1); 2026-10-22.

Correct 1.75 d1acca_ (43828, f.11.1.1) and correct 2.08 domains with SUNIDs, spans, folds, superfamilies, families, and classes. Excellent limits: no homology assertion between modules without claiming convergence, refusal to transfer toxin function, calcium binding, receptor specificity, or oligomeric state from a domain-level match, and acknowledgment that no quality comparison was retrieved. Attributes the two-domain state only to 2.07 and 2.08, omitting that the change began in 2.04 after persisting through 2.03. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

All five SIDs, boundaries, SCCS correct; d3jb9a5 47-697 as new fold d.394 (SUNID 345891) with fold annotation comment matching the bundle. Mosaic conclusion, reused modules vs Prp8-specific new fold distinguished, superfamily membership supports ancestry but not retained activities, notes SCOPe cannot determine assembly order, lists required external evidence. No errors.

Identifies family a.298.1.1 as the deepest homology-bearing level with correct lineage, attributes length differences to 're' repeat-number variation, cites the 'single repeat' comment and the canonical representative repeat 4cj9 A:259-292 while noting those coordinates apply only to d4cj9a_. Lengths 51/373/752 are correctly attributed to the original-style SEQRES domain sequences in its bundle. States explicitly that placement does not establish repeat counts, specificity, function, or interchangeable templates. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 judge; timestamp 2026-10-22.

Metadata correct and evidence-supported, and it correctly refuses to treat the periodic label as a replacement stable release. However it explicitly advises citing 2.08 'not the dated periodic label', which contradicts the requirement to preserve the dated label when periodic-only entries are used and would make periodic-based analyses irreproducible. Also omits the additive, non-rewriting meaning of periodic updates, hedging instead that the metadata cannot establish what was added. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Complete and accurate: a.47.2.1 co-placement with correct SUNIDs; cites the spectrin-repeat fragment comment and ms inconsistency on d1br0a_ and all 1ez3 domains; cites the four-long-helix STAT-like fold description; explicitly says the local spectrin resemblance must not be promoted to a complete-domain fold model or spectrin ancestry; fold alone does not imply homology while family/superfamily do. Correctly reports 1dn1 obsolete -> 3c98, d1dn1b_ automated match to d3c98b_, and that automation is provenance not quality. Appropriately limits template/function transfer and notes the API does not expose historical curator rationale. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct and bundle-supported: c.2.1 51735 in c.2, c.31.1 52467 in c.31, family d.58.20.1 55036 in d.58.20/d.58 and class d; c.31.1 opposite-direction comment and c.2 'nucleotide-binding modes similar' comment both confirmed by annotations; fold homology endpoint warning (homology not implied above superfamily) correctly interpreted as absence of assertion, not nonhomology. Level-dependent reasoning is precise; convergence consistent but not proof of independent origin. Chemical-constraint explanation, notes divergent homologs can change cofactor/substrate/mechanism; refuses function/template transfer; integrates global alignment, core sequence correspondence, motif context, boundaries, phylogeny, biochemical evidence. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Accurate release contrast: 2.04 ColG copies d1nqda_/d1nqdb_ in b.23.2.1 CUB-like versus Cry3A d1dlca1 (A:500-644) in b.18.1.3, sharing only the non-homology-bearing class; 2.08 ColG in b.18.1.36 (SUNID 267607) with Cry3A retained in b.18.1.3 (SUNID 49796) so the deepest shared level is superfamily b.18.1. Adds the correct 2.08 chain-B boundary change (d1nqdb1 893-1008) and flags d1nqdb2 891-892 as a synthetic tag not usable as homology evidence. Uses PubMed 17977833 plus the Cry4Ba d1w99a3 family bridge and the 1nqjA representative FATCAT match (p=0.00395, RMSD 2.52, 2.5% identity) with an explicit representative caveat. Rejects transfer of collagen specificity, Cry receptor specificity, insecticidal activity, calcium dependence, and loop/ligand templating.

Evaluator claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22. Homology retained at family and shared protein/species level; hf described as domain-level, non-inherited, different fold despite similar sequence and SS count; correctly notes exemplar identity is not established by the API; rejects interchangeable topology, coordinates, residue correspondence, binding geometry and function transfer; mutant/NHE context noted; requires structural alignment, sequence alignment, state evidence and quality measurements; datasets retain hf caveat, exclude or stratify under uniform-fold labels, and avoid cross-split placement without clustering or ASTRAL-style nonredundancy. SUNIDs 94286, 125655, 46690, 46689 and release 2.08 match the bundle. Complete.

All must_include met: family relationship not erased by fr; coverage-aware alignment with absent positions as missing data; d1o5dt2 not sole representative, completeness-verified domain selected for full-domain representation, fragment labeled/stratified when relevant; missing portion not counted as diversity. Quality values correctly rounded (0.28747 vs 0.02158), methods correct, and correctly states technical quality cannot compensate for missing content; notes absence of fr flag on d1uc6a1 is not proof of completeness. Identifiers and boundaries correct; function/template transfer rejected. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Meets all must_include items: new superfamily given convincing fold resemblance; new family as stronger probable-common-origin claim with a closer subgroup; new fold only if arrangement/topology differ, not for lack of homology evidence; placements described as hypotheses revisable with structural alignment, core sequence correspondence, motifs, architecture, phylogeny, experiments. Correctly notes SPACI/AEROSPACI measure quality, not homology. The 'consulted API identifies SCOPe 2.08' claim has no supporting evidence bundle (noncentral, correct in substance). Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Correct hierarchy with SUNIDs (d.144.1 = 56112; d.144.1.7 = 88854; d.144.1.6 = 64411; d.144.1.4 = 56171) all verified in bundle (children/parents/homology endpoints). Superfamily-level common ancestry stated as stronger than fold similarity; shared kinase-like framework; explicit named rejection of transferring protein/peptide recognition and activation-loop control, aminoglycoside specificity, and phosphoinositide head-group/membrane/partner regulation; also excludes inhibitor sensitivity, oligomeric state, pathway role. Required evidence types (sequence alignment of catalytic/specificity residues, structural superposition, substrate/nucleotide-bound structures, kinetics, mutagenesis, full-length domain context, PTM, membrane, partners, cellular, phylogenetic) are listed. No material errors. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.
